name: Arcane Shift
blurb: Active:  Ezreal  blinks to the target location and fires a bolt that strikes the nearest enemy, dealing magic damage.

effects.description: Active: Ezreal blinks from his current location to up to 475 units towards the target location, then fires a homing bolt towards the nearest enemy that deals magic damage and reveals them for 1 second.
Arcane Shift prioritizes firing at the nearest enemy marked by Essence Flux.
The target does not have to be visible to be hit by this ability.

notes:
If Ezreal is moved during the cast time, his range to blink will update accordingly. This does not exceed the maximum target range.
The target is revealed as soon as Ezreal fires the missile at them.
